scenes.headline: How this week's open decision models work
scenes.sub: The most serious releases yet, and the smallest benchmarks.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cayenne! Week three brought the most serious open decision models yet, and the smallest benchmarks.

scenes.text: A typed decision model returns a probability for every option in one forward pass, instead of writing a label and parsing it.
scenes.say: A decision model answers typed questions in one pass. No text to write, no JSON to parse, nothing to repair.

left.title: Chat + harness
left.say: The usual way asks a chat model to write a label, then parses whatever comes back and hopes it is valid.

right.title: Decision model
items: Read the answer off the logits
right.say: A decision model reads the answer straight off the logits in one pass, with a probability for every option.

steps.say: Point the official client at your own server instead of the hosted model.
Behind one door, any open decision model answers: a letter reader, a pointer, or a trained joint head.

scenes.title: JevBench, the outside test
scenes.note: of 231 public items — a two-item loss, filed under 'not significant'
scenes.say: On the one benchmark nobody here ran themselves, the loud win turns quietly into a two-item loss behind Jev.

scenes.label: parameters in the week's oddball, about one millisecond a decision
scenes.note: no language model; it builds mechanical parts
scenes.say: The one release that shipped a measured calibration number is a tiny decider, a hundred times smaller than the rest, a millisecond each.

scenes.text: The models grew up. The benchmarks got smaller: every win is the publisher's own, and none is on sealed items.
scenes.mark: every win is the publisher's own
scenes.say: The models grew up, and the benchmarks got smaller. Every win this week is the publisher's own run.

recap: One pass reads a decision, no parsing
One serving layer, many open models
Every win is self-run; none sealed
scenes.say: To recap: one pass reads the decision, one API serves them all, and every win this week is self-run.
